name: 10121-decode-8b-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:2), sm90, NVLink between the two cards.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one node.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 128256, bf16; 8.03e9 parameters, 16.06 GB of weights, ~8 GB per GPU at TP=2.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 1280 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion, seed static 10121.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 128 tokens and output EXACTLY 1024 (min = max on both), greedy (temperature 0.0), and ignore_eos is forced with max_tokens so all 1024 tokens are generated. `request_format: plain` -- the prompt string reaches the engine as-is with no chat template applied, so the engine sees the 128 tokens the dataset produced.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token drafts from short prompts for 64 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.6.4-era engine arguments, fed to AsyncEngineArgs rather than to a CLI: an unknown key
# is a TypeError at engine construction, and `compilation-config` must stay an int (EngineArgs
# promotes it into a full CompilationConfig). Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

# The named checkpoint from its ungated mirror; already in the local HF cache.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 2
compilation-config: 3
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
